Today's selection covers 113 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 71 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic Joins the A.I. Agent Race With Claude Duet

• **Security Alert**: Authorities disrupt nearly 11,000 cybercrime networks in Africa

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 60 articles published in the last 24 hours
